value.note: A second floor lever two cells west of the first valve.

why: A world edit places a second floor lever two cells west of the first valve's. The valve is a lever the party pulls, and now a lever of the same kind stands within the click's reach of it, with nothing to say which one is the valve. Refused naming the valve, the block and the twin's cell and distance. The remedies — move the twin, change the prop to a block the scene has one of, or mark the act — are the ones the gallery itself took for the second and third valves, which are buttons for exactly this reason.
